title: Overview of Customer and Partner Onboarding Journeys

chapters.title: Standard trial experience vs. partner-led journey

features.name: Prospect profiling on partner website
features.description: Partners can profile prospects on their website to understand industry, business type, and current systems, then redirect them to a personalized trial experience.

features.name: Dynamic AppSource app loading
features.description: Partners can select and load a relevant AppSource app into the trial based on the prospect profile information collected from the partner website.

features.name: Profile data carried through onboarding journey
features.description: Profile information collected on the partner website is carried through the signup and trial process and made available in Business Central to pivot the experience based on customer preferences.

features.name: Embedded buying experience
features.description: Partners can build an embedded buying experience into the trial that handles the CSP relationship part and takes prospects through onboarding into their own company.

features.name: Dynamic data loading for new company
features.description: The system can dynamically load customer data such as chart of accounts and posting groups when setting up a new company during onboarding.
